exercises.task: Some resources are public, some are private. Count how many need a login, and print the count.

exercises.expectedOutput:
1. login form
2. search box
3. url ?page=
4. file upload
exercises.hint: forEach gives you the item and its index — add 1 so numbering starts at 1.
exercises.solution:
const doors = ["login form", "search box", "url ?page=", "file upload"];
doors.forEach((door, i) => console.log((i + 1) + ". " + door));
